arabic text: BE PARDA HARAM SHAAM KE BAZAARO ME JANA, SAJJAD SE PUCHO
english translation text: GOING INTO THE BAZAAR OF SHAAM WITHOUT A COVERING, ASK SAJJAD

arabic text: AUR NAAM E NABI ZADI KA DARBAR ME AANA, SAJJAD SE PUCHO
english translation text: AND HEARING THE NAME OF THE GRANDDAUGHTER OF THE PROPHET IN THE COURT, ASK SAJJAD

arabic text: CHALEES SHABO ROZ KI JAAGI HUI ZAINAB GASH KHAKE GIRI JAB. US WAQT SITAMGAAR KA DURRO SE JAGANA, SAJJAD SE PUCHO
english translation text: THE GRIEF TO SEE ZAINAB FAINTING AND FALLING DOWN AFTER BEING AWAKE FOR 40 DAYS AND NIGHTS;\nAND AT THAT MOMENT TO BE AWOKEN BY THE WHIP OF THE TYRANT; ASK SAJJAD

arabic text: MASOOM SAKINA NE JO HAATHO KO UTHAAYA BABA KO BULAYA. BETI KI SADA PAR SARE SHABBIR KA AANA, SAJJAD SE PUCHO
english translation text: THE INNOCENT SAKINA RAISED HER HANDS AND ASKED FOR HER FATHER TO COME BACK, BY THE CALL OF SAKINA THE HEAD OF HUSSAIN CAME INSTEAD, ASK SAJJAD

arabic text: MAA BEHNO KE SAR KO JO KHULA DEKH NA PAYA HAIDER KA DULAARA. NAIZE SE ZAMI PAR SARE ABBAS KA AANA, SAJJAD SE PUCHO
english translation text: THE SON OF HAIDER COULD NOT BEAR SEEING THE UNCOVERED HEADS OF THE MOTHERS AND SISTER, AT THAT MOMENT, ABBAS' HEAD FELL ONTO THE GROUND, ASK SAJJAD

arabic text: TAREEK YE ZINDAN WOH SAKINA WOH ANDHERA JAB MAUT NE GHERA. UN AKHRI LAMHAAT ME BABA KO BULANAA, SAJJAD SE PUCHO
english translation text: ASK SAJJAD\nTHE DARKNESS OF THE DUNGEON WHERE YOUNG SAKINA PASSED AWAY, CALLING OUT TO HER BELOVED FATHER HUSSAIN (A.S) IN HER LAST MOMENTS,

arabic text: ROTA THA KABHI SOCH KE WOH ALAAME GURBAT HAR LAMHA QAYAMAT. ANKHO SE LAHU KALB KA HAR GHAM BAHANA. SAJJAD SE PUCHO
english translation text: ASK SAJJAD\nHE CRIED EVERY MOMENT, THINKING OF THE SUFFERINGS (OF THE FAMILY OF PROPHET), HOW PAINFUL IT IS TO WEEP THE TEARS OF BLOOD;
